notes: The baseline reuses the same 108 Qwen grounded Round-0 programs as the full method.
Only the 32 initially unsuccessful programs receive the two-stage Self-Debugging explanation and repair call.

The baseline receives the original grounded task, previous program, raw execution observation, and a binary hidden-test rejection; it does not receive PA-SCoRe semantic mismatch categories, affected paths, expected arrays, expected hashes, or numerical answers.
